locations.label: The Lion
locations.description:
Used as part of the main quest to unlock the incantations and the Mystic Orb.
To upgrade you will need to kill a glowing parasite (4 of them spawn upon picking up the sword for the first time), bring the glow that will appear on your sword, and hit the lion door, located in the town with it.

locations.label: The Dragon
locations.description:
Used as part of the main quest to unlock the incantations and the Mystic Orb.
To upgrade you will need to take the sword to the dragon statue at the top of the stairs by the castle entrance.

locations.label: The Raven
locations.description:
Used as part of the main quest to unlock the incantations and the Mystic Orb.
To upgrade you will need to find a statue in the Alchemical Lab with an animal part. Then head to the pub basement.

locations.label: The Stag
locations.description:
Used as part of the main quest to unlock the incantations and the Mystic Orb.
To upgrade you will need to find all 3 lighting rods, place them in the container and complete a lockdown.

locations.label: Upgrade - The Lion
locations.description:
Upgrades the bastard sword to it's elemental variant.
A door with a lion emblem. Once your sword is glowing from killing a glowing parasite, hit this door with it to light up 1 of 4 sybmols. After doing all 4, interact with the door to start a lockdown. Once inside place the sword in the pedestal and shoot 4 hovering symbols that appear in the order they light up on the pedestal.

locations.label: Upgrade - The Dragon
locations.description:
Upgrades the bastard sword to it's elemental variant.
After placing the sword in the statue, bring 3 flames from brasiers around the map, back to the statue. You can melee zombies to regain health

locations.label: Upgrade - The Raven
locations.description:
Upgrades the bastard sword to it's elemental variant.
Find the circular puzzle. Place the antiquity that you picked up, then place the sword. Figure out the zodiac symbol and Aristotelian element that represents the antiquity, then align the 2 correct sybmbols. After doing this you will need to guide orbs into portals 3 times.

locations.label: Upgrade - The Stag
locations.description: Place the three lightning rods in the rampart urn, complete its storm charging sequence with the Stag sword, then insert the charged sword to forge Durendal.

locations.label: Brasier #1
locations.description:
Used as part of the sword upgrade quest.
1 of 3
Will be lit only after placing the sword in the statue. When interacted with will enpower the user and they must get back to the statue and interact with it.

locations.description:

locations.label: Antiquity
locations.description:
Used as part of the sword upgrade quest.
Used for the Raven Sword upgrade.
Found in the Alchemical Lab on any of the shelves around the room. Will be random and one of several variants. Once obtained, must be placed in the circular puzzle in the pub to activate it.

locations.label: Ritual Item - The Lion
locations.description:
Paladin's Brooch
Obtained by shooting each red crystal light along the walls, starting with the one above the fireplace in the dining room. Aim the light beam at the next one, by shooting it from the left or right side of each crystal.

locations.label: Ritual Item Step - The Dragon
locations.description:
Wood Bundle
Needs to be ignited using any source of fire e.g. molotov, fire sword, incendiary. Once all 3 are lit, a Doppelghast will spawn, kill it to obtain the Ankh Charm

locations.label: Ritual Item - The Raven
locations.description:
Raven Talon
Obtained by taking the sewer exit from the castle and shooting the Raven in the tunnel. Once out of the pipe, shoot the raven in the sky for it to drop it's talon.

locations.label: Ritual Item Step - The Stag
locations.description:
Otto's Horseshoe
Shoot it from above the doorframe in the barn by deadshot.

locations.label: Ritual Item - The Stag
locations.description: Reference area for collecting Pegasus’ Horseshoe after the cannon launch. Follow the current storm cloud; the marker is not a guaranteed landing point.

locations.label: Ritual - The Lion
locations.description: Place the ritual item, get kills to charge it. When finished an incantation box will appear, use the upgraded sword of the correct type to open the box.

locations.label: Symbol Wall
locations.description: When punched with Melee Macchiato it reveals a wall of symbols that must be shot in the corresponding order to symbols shown on the bottles in the pub that appear after talking to Kraft. After the sequence is complete, it reveals a book to the left that allows you to place the torn pages found in the common room.

locations.label: Secret Study
locations.description:
The door is revealed after activating and completing all point of power traps, in the correct order as shown in the book next to the symbol wall.
The wall can only be opened after obtaining the Mystic Orb

locations.label: Mystic Orb
locations.description: The Mystic Orb appears in Dining Hall after the knight salute sequence. Follow the guide’s current order: matching incantation, then inspect the matching elemental sword at each knight.

locations.label: Orb Pedestal - The Lion
locations.description: Requires the Orb to begin. Starts a timed event to complete, run to each large green orb as fast as possible to charge the orb, no killing is necessary, when completed correctly the orb will have a coloured effect flying around it. They can be completed in any order, must be picked up to begin another.

locations.label: Orb Pedestal - The Dragon
locations.description: Requires the Orb to begin. Starts a timed event to complete, kill zombies with any fire damage including the alt fire of the Dragon sword to charge the orb, when completed correctly the orb will have a coloured effect flying around it. They can be completed in any order, must be picked up to begin another.

locations.label: Orb Pedestal - The Raven
locations.description: Requires the Orb to begin. Starts a timed event to complete, kill zombies with shadow rift effects, including Kazimir devices and the alt fire of the Raven sword to charge the orb, when completed correctly the orb will have a coloured effect flying around it. They can be completed in any order, must be picked up to begin another.

locations.label: Orb Pedestal - The Stag
locations.description: Requires the Orb to begin. Starts a timed event to complete, kill zombies with any electrical effect, including the alt fire of the Stag sword to charge the orb, when completed correctly the orb will have a coloured effect flying around it. They can be completed in any order, must be picked up to begin another.

locations.label: Guardian Key
locations.description: Found after opening the Study door with the charged orb by performing all 4 orb rituals. This recording can be activated and collected in order to begin the bossfight, back at spawn.

locations.label: Boss Fight
locations.description: A boss fight for this map, follow the main quest to begin.

locations.label: Bartending Egg
locations.description:
After collecting all 3 bottles, you can come back here to trigger the easter egg that rewards you with intel and a free PHD flopper perk.
Interact with the silver tray at the end of the bar to activate.

locations.label: Cannon Part - Wheel
locations.description: Inside a box of banana's at spawn, only appears after turning the cannon the first time.

locations.label: Cannon Part - Blowtorch
locations.description: In the back right corner of the dining hall, beside the standing light.

locations.label: Clock Tower Monkey Bomb
locations.description: Requires a lot of patience and 50k essence. You must go through the cannon 100 times total, on the 100th firing you will fly into the bell and it will drop 2 monkey bombs and behave as a monkey bomb for a prolonged time.

locations.label: Free Perk - Peeks #1
locations.description:
Find all Mr Peeks dolls in a specific order, to unlock a free perk! Originally found by one of the creators!
Can only be seen and shot through the window from inside, must be the first one shot.

locations.label: Free Perk - Peeks #2
locations.description:
Find all Mr Peeks dolls in a specific order, to unlock a free perk! Originally found by one of the creators!
Can be seen from inside the barn, inside the castle wall, far away from the barn. A scope is recommended but not required, must be the second one shot. Listen for the audio queue and pink light.

locations.label: Free Perk - Peeks #3
locations.description:
Find all Mr Peeks dolls in a specific order, to unlock a free perk! Originally found by one of the creators!
In the window of a tower far in the distance. Similar to #2, a scope is recommended but not required.

locations.label: Free Perk - Peeks #4
locations.description:
Find all Mr Peeks dolls in a specific order, to unlock a free perk! Originally found by one of the creators!
Final location, sat on the bench inside the cell.

locations.label: Max Armour

locations.label: Insta Kill
locations.description: Up on the scaffolding. Can be seen from the stairs.

locations.label: Double Points
locations.description: Low to the ground, on a shelf on the left side inside the zombie spawn.

locations.label: Full Power
locations.description: Up on the roof, balancing on a broken wooden beam.

locations.label: Nuke
locations.description: Can be seen out in the distance against the castle walls when viewing from the barn gate next to the ammo box.

locations.label: Bonus Points
locations.description: Behind the back of the sofa.

locations.label: Fire Sale
locations.description:
Only appears after shooting all 7 other power ups.
Inside the well.

targets.title: Cannon → Pack-a-Punch
targets.description: Cannon opens castle → Oubliette crate locks → Doppelghast crystal → Pack-a-Punch.

targets.title: Krafft’s cell & Alchemical Lab
targets.description: Speak to Krafft in Dungeon; open Alchemical Lab; prepare armor and Melee Macchiato.

targets.title: Four knight sword statues
targets.description: Round 10 onward: four Stamps → Dragon, Stag, Raven and Lion swords.

targets.title: Dragon statue & three braziers
targets.description: Dragon statue → carry all three brazier flames home → collect Caliburn.

targets.title: Three lightning rod references
targets.description: Rods: Deadshot ground pickup; Dead Wire box near Speed Cola; Dungeon zombie with Stag sword.

targets.title: Stag sword storm urn
targets.description: Storm vase: charge sword → melee vase, three times → insert sword → Durendal.

targets.title: Antiquity search · Alchemical Lab
targets.description: Alchemical Lab antiquity + Raven sword → Tavern Cellar rune wheel.

targets.title: Raven sword wheel · Tavern Cellar
targets.description: Align the correct element and zodiac at six o’clock; confirm.

targets.title: Raven sword upgrade room
targets.description: Guide three orbs into each of three portals → return to wheel → Balmung.

targets.title: Lion sword door
targets.description: Four gold Parasite melee charges → four strikes on the lion door → enter.

targets.title: Lion sword upgrade entrance
targets.description: Pedestal displays target → shoot matching floating symbol; repeat four times → Solais.

targets.title: Wood bundles & fire ritual
targets.description: Light three high pyres → kill spawned enemies → Ankh to Courtyard → Fire Incantation.

targets.title: Horseshoe references & electric ritual
targets.description: Stable horseshoe → ride cannon → retrieve horseshoe under storm cloud → Town Square ritual.

targets.title: Raven release & dark ritual
targets.description: Shoot slide raven → shoot flying raven → talon to Undercroft ritual → Dark Incantation.

targets.title: Paladin’s Brooch & light ritual
targets.description: Align red crystal beams → collect brooch from lab bust → Dining Hall ritual → Light Incantation.

targets.title: Undercroft symbol wall
targets.description: Melee Macchiato wall → record bottle runes I–VI → shoot matching sequence.

targets.title: Four Sitting Rooms page search areas
targets.description: Four Sitting Rooms page fragments → restore the Undercroft book.

targets.title: Six Point of Power traps
targets.description: Match and finish four traps in book order; confirm each page dims.

targets.title: Knight statues & Mystic Orb
targets.description: Read I–IV animal order → matching sword + incantation + inspect → take Mystic Orb.

targets.title: Fire orb pedestal
targets.description: Courtyard orb: fire kills → retrieve charged orb.

targets.title: Electric orb pedestal
targets.description: Town Square orb: electric kills → retrieve orb.

targets.title: Dark orb pedestal
targets.description: Undercroft orb: shadow kills → retrieve orb.

targets.title: Light orb pedestal
targets.description: Dining Hall orb: run through green light orbs → retrieve completed orb.

targets.title: Secret Study & Guardian Key
targets.description: Charged orb → Secret Study → recording → Guardian Key; resupply before committing.

targets.title: Guardian encounter start
targets.description: Town Square statue key → break armor → focus glowing weak points.

targets.title: Three liquor bottles & Tavern tray
targets.description: Three liquor bottles → Tavern serving game → match drink colors → PhD Flopper.

targets.title: Peeks hide-and-seek · four-shot order
targets.description: Peeks: Elemental Pop window → stable hole → Dining Hall high window → Dungeon cell.

targets.title: Cave slide raven release reference
targets.description: Follow the released raven alive for several laps → perk → shoot later for talon.

targets.title: Undercroft rune wall
targets.description: Four incantations on dim rune wall → three-wave defense → reward loot.

targets.title: Cannon gear & blowtorch
targets.description: Town Square fruit-crate gear + Dining Hall fireplace blowtorch → repair cannon.
